title: Odometer Bands and the Evidence a Fault Report Carries
content:
The highest odometer reading standing on the condition record of a Keyturn Vehicle Listing places the vehicle in one of three mileage bands, and the band decides what is added to the evidence a fault report carries.

| Highest odometer reading standing on the condition record | Added |
| --- | --- |
| 60000 miles or more | 4 photographs |
| 30000 miles or more but below 60000 | 2 photographs |
| below 30000 miles | 0 photographs |

The reading read is the highest standing on the record, not the most recent one, so a later reading that is lower than an earlier one does not move the vehicle down a band.

*At the boundaries.* A vehicle whose highest standing reading is exactly 60000 miles is in the top band and adds 4 photographs; at 59999 miles it is in the middle band and adds 2. At exactly 30000 miles it is in the middle band and adds 2 photographs; at 29999 miles it is in the bottom band and adds nothing on this ground.
